title.zh: Galaxy adds $100 million in Sky’s sUSDS to treasury, buys SKY token as firms deepen lending ties

current_state.zh: Galaxy allocated $100 million in Sky's sUSDS to its corporate treasury, bought SKY tokens, and approved the savings token as collateral for institutional lending, deepening its partnership with Sky.
